title: data(wood): sourced shrinkage for 10 species (FPL 4-3/4-4, CIRAD Tropix); add Tropix as a policy source
intent: Replace unsourced or lower-priority tangential/radial shrinkage in wood_species.json for the 10 species that had a value and a CIRAD Tropix sheet under the same name (nine single-species sheets; Wenge's sheet covers a two-species trade group, M. laurentii and M. stuhlmannii), following the source priority in CLAUDE.md: FPL GTR-282 Tables 4-3/4-4 for the 8 species FPL covers, Tropix (owner-approved 2026-11-15, one sheet at a time, cited per value) for the 2 it does not. Adds CIRAD_Tropix to the data policy and update template.
behavior_change: wood_movement_calc results change for bubinga, jatoba, ipe, khaya, ovangkol, purpleheart, cedar_western_red, douglas_fir, african_padauk and wenge, because their shrinkage coefficients change (e.g. purpleheart tangential 9.61 -> 6.1 %, khaya 5.8 -> 4.5 %). No code, route or schema change; no other field or species changed.

diff_articulation.what_changed: wood_species.json: contraction_tangential_pct / contraction_radial_pct (and Douglas-fir volumetric) for 10 species, each with per-field _shrinkage_<dir>_source plus FPL table row or Tropix sheet URL and sheet date; African padauk's combined _shrinkage_source key split into per-field keys. CLAUDE.md and the update template: CIRAD_Tropix added as shrinkage priority 2 with the no-bulk-extraction rule; CIRAD density-database line clarified. VERIFICATION_LOG: C-14 (before/FPL/Tropix/after table and findings) and O-12. Review fixes: Ovangkol table-row labels spell Guibourtia ehie and note FPL Table 4-4's own misprint (Guibourta, sic); the update template's source priority is split per property so density reads FPL, CIRAD density database, Wood Database, as in CLAUDE.md.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Four of these values had no source (ipe and purpleheart shared identical placeholder numbers), and the policy's FPL-first rule had not been applied to the JSON for species FPL Table 4-4 covers; C-11 fixed documents only and left the JSON unchanged.

commands_run: JSON round-trip check: json.dumps(indent=2, ensure_ascii=True) reproduces origin/main's file byte-for-byte before editing
scripted diff vs origin/main: 10 species changed; all non-shrinkage fields of all 473 records identical; _meta identical
each FPL value read from docs/reference/fpl-gtr282/fpl_gtr282_species_tables.csv, same rows as scripts/check_tonewood_fpl_values.py aliases
each Tropix value read from its own sheet PDF; St/Sr agrees with the sheet's printed ratio for all 11 sheets read
wood_movement_calc.get_shrinkage_data returns the new values for ipe, purpleheart, wenge, african_padauk, khaya, douglas_fir

files.intent: Data policy: CIRAD_Tropix as shrinkage source priority 2 (per value, one sheet at a time, never bulk-extracted); valid source value added; CIRAD density-database line clarified.
Template source priority split per property to match CLAUDE.md (shrinkage: FPL, Tropix, Wood Database; density: FPL, CIRAD density database, Wood Database); CIRAD_Tropix valid source value added.

C-14 record of the 10 changes with FPL and Tropix cross-check values; O-12 open issue for the remaining unsourced and missing shrinkage values. Limitations stated explicitly: Douglas-fir Coast row for a generic record, Wenge trade-group sheet, Khaya least-conservative FPL values.
Sourced tangential/radial shrinkage for 10 species with per-field attribution.
files.behavior_change: Wood-movement results for these 10 species change with their shrinkage coefficients.

risk_rationale: Medium data/provenance risk, low runtime risk: no code, route or schema changes, but wood-movement calculator outputs change for 10 species. Known limitations: douglas_fir is a generic record given FPL's Coast row; wenge is a single-species record given a two-species trade-group Tropix sheet; khaya takes policy-priority FPL values that are the least conservative of the three sources compared (FPL 4.5/2.5, Tropix 5.5/3.7, Wood Database 5.8/3.5).
